user.title: Setup GeoHome
user.description: Enter your Geo Home account details. Leave the history date empty to collect new complete hours from setup onward, or choose a date to request older electricity readings.

init.title: Electricity history
init.description: Choose a UTC start date to extend history. Leave empty to keep existing coverage. Existing readings are retained. Use the Import electricity history action for a one-off date range.

confirm.title: Confirm history settings
confirm.description: Requested start: {start_date}. Saving starts the import in batches. It does not change the Energy dashboard source or delete existing sensor history.

error.future_date: Choose today or an earlier date.
